facts.finding: The disclosed task carries source identity, execution address and data address.
PDS execution may populate shared data directly or through DMA before queuing an execution task.
Some output storage persists across grouped requests until a macro-task completion signal.
Sequential output dependencies wait for earlier same-source tasks, with optional overlap masks.
An instruction marked Last frees the thread and input/temporary storage, but does not free output storage.
The consuming processing pipeline signals output-buffer release after reading emitted output.
Individual pixel invocations write shared output; an event task emits the completed tile rather than each fragment emitting externally.
Vertex processing emits each processed vertex toward the tiling engine.

inferences.finding: The published architecture suggests separating external COLOR backing, per-thread storage and persistent tile-output lifetime in future experiments. It does not prove SGX535 preservation or any load encoding.

discriminating_experiments.question: Which documented termination instruction releases a shader thread while retaining output storage?
discriminating_experiments.minimum_prerequisite: An authorized SGX535 rev121 instruction-width/format and termination specification or wholly independently authored proven terminating program, plus qualified launch path.
discriminating_experiments.discriminant: With an independently admitted program only: separate thread-completion observations from output-consumer completion and retirement. Output release before consuming completion is rejection.

discriminating_experiments.question: Does an admitted load path read external seeded COLOR into persistent tile output, or merely initialize tile output independently?
discriminating_experiments.minimum_prerequisite: Independently established COLOR load command plus shader-policy-admitted program and exact owned resource mapping.
discriminating_experiments.discriminant: Distinct per-pixel seeds and exact untouched-pixel comparison; distinguish seeded backing visibility from tile-store persistence.
